documentation_excerpts.text: Harbor is a framework from the creators of [Terminal-Bench](https://www.tbench.ai) for evaluating and optimizing agents and language models. You can use Harbor to:

- Evaluate arbitrary agents like Claude Code, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and more. - Build and share your own benchmarks and environments. - Conduct experiments in thousands of environments in parallel through providers like Daytona, Modal, LangSmith, Blaxel, Novita Sandbox, Tensorlake, Runta, and Sail. - Generate rollouts for RL optimization.
Check out the [Harbor Cookbook](https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor-cookbook) for end-to-end examples and guides.
